lead: A `?T` narrows only inside a bare `if ($x != null)`, and `&&` does not do it.
body: `E0459` refuses `$row->date("d")->format(...)` and its help names that spelling, but `if ($a != null && $b != null)` fails on both receivers just the same, and so does negating the test into an `else`. The compact spelling is `$x?->member() ?? "null"`, one line a column as `examples/db.nvs`'s `Db\Row` readers are written, instead of a nested pyramid of `if`s.
